Per month this year, show work orders op.sql:
WITH s0 AS 
(SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', t0.opened_at) AS DATE) AS period, count(*) AS value 
FROM work_orders AS t0 
WHERE t0.opened_at >= %(param_1)s::TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE AND t0.opened_at < %(param_2)s::TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE AND t0.opened_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', t0.opened_at) AS DATE)), 
s1 AS 
(SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', t0.completed_at) AS DATE) AS period, count(*) AS value 
FROM work_orders AS t0 
WHERE t0.completed_at >= %(param_3)s::TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE AND t0.completed_at < %(param_4)s::TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE AND t0.completed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', t0.completed_at) AS DATE))
 SELECT periods.period AS period, coalesce(s0.value, 0) AS opened, coalesce(s1.value, 0) AS completed 
FROM (SELECT s0.period AS period 
FROM s0 UNION SELECT s1.period AS period 
FROM s1) AS periods LEFT OUTER JOIN s0 ON s0.period = periods.period LEFT OUTER JOIN s1 ON s1.period = periods.period ORDER BY periods.period
